## 简介 / About
Miuseshare，AestheticMiuseshare 审美体系下的音乐创作项目。
收集并探索世界各地的音乐风格，融合各地人文历史与传统音乐，以游记的方式叙述、表达全新的音乐作品。
注重艺术内涵和文化底蕴的独立艺术创作者，将音乐、图像、文字融合到作品当中。
Miuseshare, a music project under the AestheticMiuseshare aesthetic system.
Exploring musical styles around the world, integrating local history, culture and traditional music, presenting new works in the form of musical travelogues.
An independent art creator focused on artistic connotation and cultural heritage, weaving music, imagery and text into works.
